promp.railway_automation.map_locator.dif: Cannot place tracks towards a different dimension
promp.railway_automation.map_locator.unr: Current facing cannot reach the target position
When right-clicked with an encoded locator
Place _tracks_ and pave them all alone to the _stored location_
tooltip.railway_automation.map_locator.b: _Clear_ the location stored inside the locator
railway_automation.config.track_placer.m: Largest height difference (blocks) a single gentle curve may climb. Above it the climb uses a 45 degree slope with two transition curves, so a larger difference is still usable when enough horizontal distance is available.
railway_automation.config.track_placer.s: Upper bound of the horizontal length (blocks) of each curve joining a 45 degree slope. Its vertical rise is always half of this value; when horizontal room is short the curves shrink automatically (4 blocks minimum).
railway_automation.config.track_placer.g: Largest slope ratio (height difference divided by horizontal distance) of a gentle climb. When the target is far enough to keep the slope below this ratio, the whole climb becomes a single gentle curve instead of a 45 degree slope with transition curves. 0.225 equals about 12.7 degrees.
railway_automation.config.track_placer.s: Height difference (blocks) above which a 45 degree slope is always inserted. At or below this value a gentle curve is preferred, and the smaller the difference the shorter the curve the placer is willing to use.
